Title: 360{\deg} Stance Detection
Stance detection is the task of estimating whether the attitude expressed in a text towards a given topic is ‘in favour’, ‘against’, or ‘neutral’. We collected and annotated a novel dataset, which associates news articles with a stance towards a speciﬁed topic.
